up: Retrieve target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence for human single-protein targets only. Keep only targets with target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return exactly target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence.
sql:
SELECT
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.target_type,
  cs.accession AS protein_accession,
  cs.sequence AS protein_sequence
FROM target_dictionary td
JOIN target_components tc ON td.tid = tc.tid
JOIN component_sequences cs ON tc.component_id = cs.component_id
WHERE
  td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens';
